XIG-Resources JSON & NDJSON

```{r warning=FALSE, message=TRUE,}
# ---- Define JSON path (adjust as needed) ----
DATA_JSON <- here("data", "raw", "xig_resource_v1.2.json")

# ---- Read JSON directly (as array) ----
df <- fromJSON(DATA_JSON, flatten = TRUE)
df <- as_tibble(df)

# ---- Clean data: NA handling, column renaming, and type corrections ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~na_if(str_trim(as.character(.)), ""))) %>%
  rename(
    package      = package_text,
    package_url  = package_href,
    identity     = identity_text,
    identity_url = identity_href,
    title        = name_title
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    version = str_to_upper(version),                       # e.g., R4, R5
    date = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(date, c("Ymd", "Ym", "Y"))), # robust date parse
    status = str_to_lower(status),
    wg     = str_to_lower(wg),
    realm  = str_to_lower(realm),
    auth   = str_to_lower(auth)
  )

# ---- Quick preview ----
#print(head(df, 10))
print(summary(df))


```

```{r}
# Specify columns of interest
cols <- c("package", "status", "realm", "auth", "version")

# Using pivot_longer and summarise in tidyverse style
unique_counts <- df %>%
  select(all_of(cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(column) %>%
  summarise(unique_count = n_distinct(value), .groups = "drop")

print(unique_counts)

```

```{r}
filtered_table <- df %>%
  filter(
    package == "fhir.cdc.opioid-cds-r4",
    version == "R4",
    realm == "us",
    auth == "hl7",
    str_detect(identity, "^ActivityDefinition/")
  ) %>%
  select(package, identity, status, date) %>%
  arrange(desc(date))   # Sort by date descending

print(filtered_table)
```
```{r}
pivot_status_year <- df %>%
  filter(
    version == "R4",
    realm == "us",
    auth == "hl7",
    str_detect(identity, "^ActivityDefinition/")
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) %>%
  select(package, identity, version, realm, auth, year, status) %>%
  distinct(package, identity, version, realm, auth, year, status) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,          # columns: years
    values_from = status,       # cell values: status
    values_fn = ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = "; ")
  )

print(pivot_status_year)
```


```{r}

status_year_table <- df %>%
  filter(
    version == "R4",
    realm == "us",
    auth == "hl7"#,
    # str_detect(identity, "^ActivityDefinition/")
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(package, identity, version, realm, auth) %>%
  summarize(
    min_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    status_by_year = list(tibble(year = year, status = status)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(status_by_year) %>%
  distinct(package, identity, version, realm, auth, year, status) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = status,
    values_fn = ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = "; ")
  )

head(status_year_table)


```

```{r}
corrected_status_year_table <- df %>%
  filter(
    version == "R4",
    realm == "us",
    auth == "hl7",
    str_detect(identity, "^ActivityDefinition/")
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(package, identity, version, realm, auth) %>%
  summarize(
    min_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      filter(
        version == "R4",
        realm == "us",
        auth == "hl7",
        str_detect(identity, "^ActivityDefinition/")
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
      select(package, identity, version, realm, auth, year, status) %>%
      distinct(package, identity, version, realm, auth, year, status),
    by = c("package", "identity", "version", "realm", "auth")
  ) %>%
  distinct(package, identity, version, realm, auth, min_date, max_date, year, status) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = status,
    values_fn = ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = "; "),
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  arrange(package, identity)

print(corrected_status_year_table)

```


```{r}

# Specify the package and identity
packages_to_include <- c("fhir.r4.ukcore.stu3.currentbuild")
identities_to_include <- c("CodeSystem/UKCore-NHSNumberVerificationStatusEngland")

status_over_years <- df %>%
  filter(
    package %in% packages_to_include,
    identity %in% identities_to_include
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  distinct(package, identity, year, status) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = status,
    values_fn = ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = "; "), # Handles multiple statuses in a year
    values_fill = "" # blank if no status recorded that year
  )

print(status_over_years)


```
